_doc: [extras] Songs on the base radio (systems/extras/radio.gd). id: a composed track (audio/music_tracks.gd, played with Audio.play_track; the title comes from Audio.music_track_title, and a restored planet plays its restored variant). cond: when it unlocks, the condition types of data/achievements.json plus 'districts_l5' (bases at level 5), 'districts' (districts visited), 'planet_seen' (key: planet theme id, heard on that planet) and 'planet_level' (key: planet; best base level reached on that planet). No cond = on the radio from the start. hint: shown while locked. Unlocks persist in GameState.flags.radio.unlocked.
